title: PG-13.1 Federation sites, sharing classes, disclosure (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP13 in memev: Federation sites, sharing classes, disclosure. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP13.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP04-02, WP06-03, WP09-01, WP09-02, WP10-01, WP12-02. Depends on contracts: SO-2.02, PG-09.1. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-2.02: WP13-01 enforces sharing classes at the publish boundary of a site; SO-2.02 governs retrieval and action time and takes none of it. Boundary with SO-2.12: WP13-03 (sites) is a prerequisite of federated computation. Boundary with SO-2.11 and SO-2.14: WP13 concerns sites of Memev; enterprise systems and multi-person project permissions stay with those contracts. Signed vault contract SO-09-A (cited by id only): the authorisation matrix at every entry point; WP13 enforces the publish boundary of a site and does not restate it. Build layer (owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026): the unsigned fold (SO-A-01 to SO-A-12, SO-R-E, SO-F-01 to SO-F-13, cited by id only) is the build layer, and it overlaps this spec at SO-F-04, SO-F-05, SO-F-07, SO-F-12, SO-F-13. This spec will cite those ids and keep only what the fold does not cover; trim pending fold PR (the final fold ids come in a separate pull request, branch contracts/scope-one-fold-build-layer). Nothing is trimmed yet. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
